facts.text: The resort is tucked away within the medieval village of Megalohori and evolved from a 400-year-old wine cellar and a 100-year-old mansion.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away within the medieval village of Megalohori, the enchanting Vedema a Luxury Collection Resort has evolved from a 400 year old wine cellar and a 100 year old mansion into an authentic, Cycladic

facts.text: The resort is built around the 400-year-old winery at the heart of the property and resembles a traditional fortified Greek village.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by and built around the 400-year-old winery that dominates the heart of the property, the resort resembles a traditional fortified Greek village

facts.text: The resort sits on a more than 500-year-old vineyard overlooking Megalohori and was built in 1993.
facts.excerpt: Situated on a more than 500-year-old vineyard overlooking the medieval village of Megalohori, the resort was built in 1993

facts.text: Antonis Elliopoulos, son of a notable shipping family, developed the family's summer estate into the resort.
facts.excerpt: Antonis Elliopoulos, the son of a notable shipping family, had the idea of developing the family’s summer estate into an innovative first-class resort

facts.text: Architect Mary Kavagia and interior designers Yiannis Tseklenis and Aggelos Aggelopoulos created the resort as a traditional fortified Greek village.
facts.excerpt: He then commissioned renowned architect Mary Kavagia and interior designers Yiannis Tseklenis and Aggelos Aggelopoulos to create a traditional fortified Greek village

facts.text: The name Vedema is the Venetian translation for 'harvest'.
facts.excerpt: its name, Vedema, is the direct Venetian translation for 'harvest.'

facts.text: The vineyards around the hotel produce their own vintage, which guests can taste in the Canava Wine Bar.
facts.excerpt: Even today, the vineyards that surround the hotel are nurtured to produce their own special vintage, available for guests to taste in the Canava Wine Bar.

facts.text: The sunset wine ceremony in the Canava Wine Bar is a tasting of 6 indigenous wines with Greek cheeses and crackers.
facts.excerpt: The unforgettable tasting of 6 exquisite indigenous wines with an excellent variety of Greek cheeses and crackers

facts.text: All suites and villas have their own terraces, and many have jacuzzis or private pools.
facts.excerpt: All suites and villas feature their own terraces and many come with jacuzzis or private pools

facts.text: In all rooms, wooden doors open to a private terrace or patio overlooking the resort gardens.
facts.excerpt: In all rooms, characteristic wooden doors open to a private terrace or patio that overlooks the enchanting resort gardens.

facts.text: Interiors combine the angular lines of Cycladic architecture with island-sourced antique furnishings.
facts.excerpt: Integrating the fresh angular lines of Cycladic architecture with island-sourced antique furnishings

facts.text: The Nafsika Estate is hidden away in the Megalohori Caldera and offers absolute privacy and spectacular views.
facts.excerpt: Hidden away in the Megalohori Caldera, Nafsika Estate’s absolute privacy, spectacular views and enchanting ambiance

facts.text: The Nafsika Estate has caldera and sea views, a private pool and a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Estate, Caldera view, Sea view, Private pool, Whirlpool

facts.text: The Olympian Villa has vineyard and sea views and a private pool.
facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Villa, 1 King, Vineyards view, Sea view, Private pool

facts.text: A 2019 interior renovation replaced all furniture with antique, island-style pieces.
facts.excerpt: All furniture was replaced with antique, island-style offerings, sugar-white in color and upholstered in sumptuous fabrics.

facts.text: Elios Spa is set in a 100-year-old wine cellar renovated in minimalist Cycladic style.
facts.excerpt: Our fully equipped spa is located in an enchanting 100-year-old wine cellar. Renovated in minimalist Cycladic-style

facts.text: Elios Spa offers therapeutic massages, facials and body treatments.
facts.excerpt: Therapeutic massages, facials and body treatments soothe and rejuvenate.

facts.text: The Jacuzzi Bar sits among native olive and pistachio trees.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy additional relaxation with an exotic cocktail from the adjacent Jacuzzi Bar, located among native olive and pistachio trees.

facts.text: The swimming pool is not heated.
facts.excerpt: The temperature of our non-heated pool ensures a cooling, rejuvenating dip that pleasantly contrasts the warm Greek sun.

facts.text: Alati Restaurant is set in the 400-year-old winery cave with stone walls.
facts.excerpt: Alati Restaurant has evolved from the 400-year-old winery cave, made from distinctive stone walls

facts.text: With advance booking, Prive Dining serves five- or seven-course degustation menus highlighting Santorini's flavours.
facts.excerpt: Privé Dining offers the option, with an advance booking, for guests to savor, five- or seven-course degustation menus that highlight the myriad flavours of Santorini.

facts.text: Some produce for the restaurants is grown in the resort's own vegetable garden.
facts.excerpt: Some of this is cultivated in the resort’s own vegetable garden

facts.text: Guests can host a picnic on the resort's private beach.
facts.excerpt: host a romantic picnic on the resort’s private beach

facts.text: The concierge arranges daily excursions to the black, red and white beaches by private sailboat.
facts.excerpt: Daily excursions to black, red and white beaches via private sailboats

facts.text: The concierge also arranges a sunset volcano cruise.
facts.excerpt: A sunset volcano cruise

facts.text: The head concierge is a bilingual, certified destination expert.
facts.excerpt: Our head concierge is a bilingual, certified destination expert and eager to reveal the island’s secret treasures.

facts.text: The Kinship Program offers families hands-on experiences rooted in Santorini's traditions.
facts.excerpt: Our Kinship Program invites families to discover Santorini together through hands-on experiences that celebrate connection, creativity, and the island’s living traditions.

facts.text: Family experiences include farm visits, cooking classes and horseback rides through Megalochori's vineyards.
facts.excerpt: From farm visits and cooking classes to gentle spa rituals for children and horseback rides through Megalochori’s vineyards

facts.text: Vedema describes itself as a family-friendly resort of spacious suites and villas.
facts.excerpt: A stylish, family-friendly resort, Vedema houses spacious suites and villas

facts.text: The in-resort boutique sells European swimwear, Greek jewelry and international clothing and shoes.
facts.excerpt: Vedema's in-resort luxury boutique showcases a selection of the finest European swimwear, renowned Greek jewelry, and international clothing and shoes.

facts.text: The resort is located near the airport and the port of Athinios.
facts.excerpt: Vedema Resort has the advantage of being located near the airport and the port of Athinios

facts.text: Self parking and valet parking are complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests. Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: There are no accessible rooms at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No Accessible Rooms Available at this Hotel

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the resort in its Readers' Choice Awards 2017, 2018 and 2026.
facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2017, 2018, 2026

facts.text: The hotel calls itself Santorini's top spot year after year.
facts.excerpt: This ongoing fusion of traditional and contemporary makes Vedema Resort Santorini’s top spot year after year.
